say:1:1623301001:1.text: The school's new messenger hasn't come back yet. The letter I've been waiting for is already a day overdue.
say:1:1623301001:1.source_cn: 学校的新信使逾期未归，我等待的信件已迟了一日。
say:1:1623301001:1.male: The school's new messenger hasn't come back yet. The letter I've been waiting for is already a day overdue.
say:1:1623301001:1.female: The school's new messenger hasn't come back yet. The letter I've been waiting for is already a day overdue.

say:2:1623301002:1.text: Take this with you and go see what happened.
say:2:1623301002:1.source_cn: 你带着这个去看看情况。
say:2:1623301002:1.male: Take this with you and go see what happened.
say:2:1623301002:1.female: Take this with you and go see what happened.

say:3:1623301003:0.text: Zorya gently pushes a feather across the desk toward you.
say:3:1623301003:0.source_cn: 佐尔娅将一根羽毛轻轻推到你面前。
say:3:1623301003:0.male: Zorya gently pushes a feather across the desk toward you.
say:3:1623301003:0.female: Zorya gently pushes a feather across the desk toward you.

say:4:1623301004:1.text: Go. If there's trouble, deal with it.
say:4:1623301004:1.source_cn: 去吧。若遇麻烦，顺手处理掉。
say:4:1623301004:1.male: Go. If there's trouble, deal with it.
say:4:1623301004:1.female: Go. If there's trouble, deal with it.

say:0:1623302001:0.text: This is the messenger's feather. I'll use transfiguration to see where it leads.
say:0:1623302001:0.source_cn: 这是新信使的羽毛……看来得用变形术了。
say:0:1623302001:0.male: This is the messenger's feather. I'll use transfiguration to see where it leads.
say:0:1623302001:0.female: This is the messenger's feather. I'll use transfiguration to see where it leads.

say:0:1623303001:0.text: The trace isn't far from here. I should check it out.
say:0:1623303001:0.source_cn: 气息似乎距离这里不远，过去看看。
say:0:1623303001:0.male: The trace isn't far from here. I should check it out.
say:0:1623303001:0.female: The trace isn't far from here. I should check it out.

say:0:1623304001:0.text: It's right ahead, and it's not moving at all. That's not a good sign.
say:0:1623304001:0.source_cn: 就在前面，气息没有在移动……莫非真出什么情况了？
say:0:1623304001:0.male: It's right ahead, and it's not moving at all. That's not a good sign.
say:0:1623304001:0.female: It's right ahead, and it's not moving at all. That's not a good sign.

say:1:1623305001:1.text: Wait, you're a mage from the Lyceum, right?
say:1:1623305001:1.source_cn: 哇，你是莱希拉姆的魔法师吧……？！
say:1:1623305001:1.male: Wait, you're a mage from the Lyceum, right?
say:1:1623305001:1.female: Wait, you're a mage from the Lyceum, right?

say:2:1623305002:1.text: I... I can still make the delivery, I swear. I'll go right now! Just please don't tell the school I was late!
say:2:1623305002:1.source_cn: 我、我这就把信送去收信人那里！请千万别跟校方说我耽误了时间！
say:2:1623305002:1.male: I... I can still make the delivery, I swear. I'll go right now! Just please don't tell the school I was late!
say:2:1623305002:1.female: I... I can still make the delivery, I swear. I'll go right now! Just please don't tell the school I was late!

say:3:1623305003:1.text: You take a closer look at the owl messenger. Its feathers are ruffled, with bits of grass and leaves stuck to the ends of its wings. Looks like it took a bad fall.
say:3:1623305003:1.source_cn: 你打量着这位猫头鹰信使——它的羽毛被风吹落，翅尖还残留...
say:3:1623305003:1.male: You take a closer look at the owl messenger. Its feathers are ruffled, with bits of grass and leaves stuck to the ends of its wings. Looks like it took a bad fall.
say:3:1623305003:1.female: You take a closer look at the owl messenger. Its feathers are ruffled, with bits of grass and leaves stuck to the ends of its wings. Looks like it took a bad fall.

choice_prompt:4:1623305003.text: You take a closer look at the owl messenger. Its feathers are ruffled, with bits of grass and leaves stuck to the ends of its wings. Looks like it took a bad fall.
choice_prompt:4:1623305003.source_cn: 你打量着这位猫头鹰信使——它的羽毛被风吹落，翅尖还残留着草屑和落叶，显然它摔过一跤，而且并不轻。
choice_prompt:4:1623305003.male: You take a closer look at the owl messenger. Its feathers are ruffled, with bits of grass and leaves stuck to the ends of its wings. Looks like it took a bad fall.
choice_prompt:4:1623305003.female: You take a closer look at the owl messenger. Its feathers are ruffled, with bits of grass and leaves stuck to the ends of its wings. Looks like it took a bad fall.

say:5:1623305004:1.text: Really? Oh, thank goodness. I was starting to panic... Yeah, I could really use a hand.
say:5:1623305004:1.source_cn: 真的吗？那真是太好了！我、我确实需要一点帮助……
say:5:1623305004:1.male: Really? Oh, thank goodness. I was starting to panic... Yeah, I could really use a hand.
say:5:1623305004:1.female: Really? Oh, thank goodness. I was starting to panic... Yeah, I could really use a hand.

say:6:1623305006:1.text: A hawk swooped at me out of nowhere. I swerved to dodge it and strained my wing. Then a strong gust caught me midair. I couldn't steady myself and just... tumbled straight down.
say:6:1623305006:1.source_cn: 为了躲开一只攻击我的老鹰，我翅膀受了点小伤，随后又遇到...
say:6:1623305006:1.male: A hawk swooped at me out of nowhere. I swerved to dodge it and strained my wing. Then a strong gust caught me midair. I couldn't steady myself and just... tumbled straight down.
say:6:1623305006:1.female: A hawk swooped at me out of nowhere. I swerved to dodge it and strained my wing. Then a strong gust caught me midair. I couldn't steady myself and just... tumbled straight down.

say:7:1623305007:1.text: And when I crashed, one of the letters slipped out of my bag.
say:7:1623305007:1.source_cn: 而且……实话跟你说吧，我摔下来的时候，还把一封信给弄丢了。
say:7:1623305007:1.male: And when I crashed, one of the letters slipped out of my bag.
say:7:1623305007:1.female: And when I crashed, one of the letters slipped out of my bag.

say:8:1623305008:1.text: I've been searching everywhere for it. That's why I'm still stuck here. Kind mage, could you help me look?
say:8:1623305008:1.source_cn: 我找了好久都没找到，所以才耽误到现在……好心的魔法师，...
say:8:1623305008:1.male: I've been searching everywhere for it. That's why I'm still stuck here. Kind mage, could you help me look?
say:8:1623305008:1.female: I've been searching everywhere for it. That's why I'm still stuck here. Kind mage, could you help me look?

say:9:1623305009:1.text: If I go back without it... the school will punish me pretty badly.
say:9:1623305009:1.source_cn: 不然学校会让我……呃……承担很严重的后果。
say:9:1623305009:1.male: If I go back without it... the school will punish me pretty badly.
say:9:1623305009:1.female: If I go back without it... the school will punish me pretty badly.

say:11:1623305005:1.text: Yeah... I hit the ground pretty hard.
say:11:1623305005:1.male: Yeah... I hit the ground pretty hard.
say:11:1623305005:1.female: Yeah... I hit the ground pretty hard.

choice:4:1:2.text: Looks like you had a rough landing.
choice:4:1:2.male: Looks like you had a rough landing.
choice:4:1:2.female: Looks like you had a rough landing.

say:0:1623306001:0.text: This must be the missing letter. I should give it back.
say:0:1623306001:0.source_cn: 信使丢的信件应该就是这个了，去交给他。
say:0:1623306001:0.male: This must be the missing letter. I should give it back.
say:0:1623306001:0.female: This must be the missing letter. I should give it back.

say:1:1623307001:1.text: Th-thank you... I was terrified just now. I really thought I was going to lose this job.
say:1:1623307001:1.source_cn: 太、太感谢了！我刚才还以为……这份工作真的要保不住了。
say:1:1623307001:1.male: Th-thank you... I was terrified just now. I really thought I was going to lose this job.
say:1:1623307001:1.female: Th-thank you... I was terrified just now. I really thought I was going to lose this job.

say:2:1623307002:1.text: Um... could I ask one more favor? My wing's still sore, and I kind of shoved everything back into the bag. It's a mess in there.
say:2:1623307002:1.source_cn: 不过……那个，你能帮我整理一下邮包吗？我的翅膀受伤了，...
say:2:1623307002:1.male: Um... could I ask one more favor? My wing's still sore, and I kind of shoved everything back into the bag. It's a mess in there.
say:2:1623307002:1.female: Um... could I ask one more favor? My wing's still sore, and I kind of shoved everything back into the bag. It's a mess in there.

say:3:1623307003:1.text: It's my first assignment. I can't show up with bent and wrinkled mail. That would be awful.
say:3:1623307003:1.source_cn: 这可是我的第一份工作，我不能让客户收到一堆折得皱皱巴巴...
say:3:1623307003:1.male: It's my first assignment. I can't show up with bent and wrinkled mail. That would be awful.
say:3:1623307003:1.female: It's my first assignment. I can't show up with bent and wrinkled mail. That would be awful.

say:4:1623307004:1.text: Please. I really don't want to mess this up!
say:4:1623307004:1.male: Please. I really don't want to mess this up!
say:4:1623307004:1.female: Please. I really don't want to mess this up!

say:0:1623308001:0.text: Everything's organized! I can finally get moving. Thank you!
say:0:1623308001:0.source_cn: 哇！你摆得真好看！这样我就可以准备出发了，谢谢你！
say:0:1623308001:0.male: Everything's organized! I can finally get moving. Thank you!
say:0:1623308001:0.female: Everything's organized! I can finally get moving. Thank you!

say:1:1623309001:1.text: Being a messenger isn't simple work. It's important, and it comes with real risks.
say:1:1623309001:1.source_cn: 信使的职责艰巨，价值与风险并存。
say:1:1623309001:1.male: Being a messenger isn't simple work. It's important, and it comes with real risks.
say:1:1623309001:1.female: Being a messenger isn't simple work. It's important, and it comes with real risks.

say:2:1623309002:1.text: They fly through rough weather, keep an eye out for predators, and still make sure the Lyceum's letters reach their destinations in one piece.
say:2:1623309002:1.source_cn: 它们要面对风暴、绕开天敌，将莱希拉姆的信件送往伊索米亚各地。
say:2:1623309002:1.male: They fly through rough weather, keep an eye out for predators, and still make sure the Lyceum's letters reach their destinations in one piece.
say:2:1623309002:1.female: They fly through rough weather, keep an eye out for predators, and still make sure the Lyceum's letters reach their destinations in one piece.

say:3:1623309003:1.text: You gave the new messenger the help it needed. From here on out, it's up to it to finish the route and earn its wings.
say:3:1623309003:1.source_cn: 你提供了必要的帮助。之后，就交由我们的新信使自己应对吧。
say:3:1623309003:1.male: You gave the new messenger the help it needed. From here on out, it's up to it to finish the route and earn its wings.
say:3:1623309003:1.female: You gave the new messenger the help it needed. From here on out, it's up to it to finish the route and earn its wings.
